what: Hudbay Minerals mines copper, with gold and zinc alongside it, at operations in Peru, Manitoba and Arizona, and is developing the large Copper World project near Tucson.
customers: Smelters and metal traders; copper and gold sell at world prices.
money: the Snow Lake gold and copper operations
Copper Mountain and the Copper World project
moat: Operating copper mines with long lives in jurisdictions that still permit them, at a time when almost no new large copper mines are being approved anywhere.
risks: Copper and gold prices set the results
Peruvian mining faces periodic community protests and road blockades
Only five analysts cover the stock
opportunities: 11.4 times earnings and 5.4 times EBITDA with a 25.7% net margin
Revenue grew from $1.5B to $2.2B in four years
Analysts see about 100% upside, and copper demand from electrification is rising while supply is not
watch: Copper production and cash cost per pound, and Copper World permitting.
